_about: limn spacing system (2026-09-27, spacing.html). Walter Tracy's method: every side of every letter is set from its shape class as a multiple of o's side bearing (O for capitals), measured as the nearest ink inside the x-height (cap-height) band. o and O keep Quicksand's own sides and are the unit at every weight. Ratios were fitted jointly at 700 and 400 to the spacing of 14 professional fonts (rounded kin: Quicksand Nunito Fredoka Poppins Comfortaa Varela Round M+ Rounded Outfit; text: Inter Source Sans 3 Roboto Lato Liberation Sans DejaVu Sans) through a blur ('squint') model that reproduces their spacing to 7 units rms. Heavier weights give straight sides a little more against round ones (Inter 1.52 -> 1.64, Nunito 1.64 -> 1.76 from 400 to 900): every class but round is multiplied by 1 + contrast x clamp((stem - 120) / 60, -1, 1). kern: pairs that stay uneven after the classes (true exceptions), [delta at 700], scaled with the spacing (o's side x the contrast factor), on top of Quicksand's kerning and KERN_FIX.

round: oL oR cL eL dL qL gL aL bR pR
o and every bowl that faces out like o
straight: bL hL kL lL pL iL iR jL jR dR qR aR yR
a stem running the full x-height
arch: nL nR mL mR hR rL uL uR yL
a stem that turns into the arch (the spurless n, and u, its turned form)
l R: l's free right side: the tall stem wants more room than a stem inside a letter
g R: g's stem, which bends away into the tail below
c R: open: the aperture counts as the letter's own white
s L: s by trial: its open bowls hold white of their own. At light weights the thin s needs more room than the model gives (blind review, 400: os, is, ss read cramped at 0.84), so 400 sits between the fit (0.88) and the old 1.17
r R: the arm alone; white under the arm reads as the letter's own, so r before a vowel read open at 700 (Tracking, grey)
t L: the bar end; white under the bar counts. Quicksand's bar is shorter at 400, where 0.15 closed st and it (blind review: Most, lists)
t R: the bar end; Quicksand draws t's bar much longer at 700 than at 400, so this one side has its own value at each end (700, 400)

uc._note: Fitted on all three places a capital meets a letter: all caps (cap-height band), capital + lowercase and lowercase + capital (x-height band, lowercase at its classes), weighted by how often each occurs in running text. Pairs that stay uneven are kerned (kern); Quicksand's and the proof reviewers' capital and mixed-case pair kerning stays on top.

round: OL OR CL GL QL DR SL SR
O, and every side that faces out like O (S by trial lands here too)
straight: BL DL EL FL HL HR IL IR KL LL ML MR NL NR PL RL JR
a stem running the full cap height (Quicksand 1.875)
U: a stem that turns into the bowl
B R: two bowls, the lower one wider
G R: the bar and the short stem

hold._about: pairs kerned to their white rather than by a delta on the parent's kerning (small-glyphs 2026-09-28): the value is the nearest ink-to-ink white across the pair at 700 (font units), scaled at every weight with the spacing unit (o's side x the contrast factor) like the kern deltas. For pairs whose Quicksand kerning moves across the weights unlike the classes: LT is -100 at 700 but -59 at 400, which left LT 4.4 O-sides open at 400 against 3.6 at 700. LV LW LY L' L" keep their 700 proportion at 400 (within 0.1 of HH's own drift) and are not held.

set._about: pairs kerned outright (sweep 2026-09-28): the value at 700 times the spacing unit (o's side x the contrast factor), replacing the parent's kerning, KERN_FIX and the exceptions. For pairs whose parent kerning is one number at every weight or whose fix scaled with the stem, so that neither followed the white: Quicksand's g|round -20 was made for its own g (limn spaces g's right as a stem, class g R) and closed gd gq gc go 8-12 % of the letter white; its du +16 opened du 8-12 %; its rv rw +50 against KERN_FIX -35 x S/120 left rv +19 % open at 100; KERN_FIX r|stem -30 x S/120 closed rn rm rr 20 % at 900 (rn toward m). Area measure of the typesetting sweep (/tmp/limn-sweep): white over the x-height band against the median of the pair's side-class group; the spacing unit tracks that white within 3 % from 100 to 900.
set._greek: T and Y (and their Greek twins Τ Υ) against the Greek lowercase that rise to the ascender or carry a bar there: ζ ξ δ θ kern as c o on their left, which would tuck them under T's bar. The values at 700 are Inter's and Pretendard's, converted by their n|n white

bars._about: bars in line (sweep 2026-09-28): a pair whose facing sides are bars at one height (lowercase: r's arm, the bars of f t z at the x-height; capitals: T F E Z L on the right, T Z on the left, at the cap height and the baseline) keeps its inks at least clear x S apart; closer pairs open by the shortfall. At 800-900 the dilated bars of rt rf TT ff ft FT came within 0.10-0.18 S.
